initial: Fresh registry shared across north/south requests; no eviction between steps.
counterexamples: Different units on same scoped key conflicts.
south cannot receipt.get a north receipt.
desk-view cannot create transfer even if a result exists.
Same-actor identical retry within retention does not mutate twice.
fix: Partition retry identities by tenant and submitting subject before result reuse; retain body mismatch checks and current authorization. Retention is bounded, not durable exactly-once delivery.
